purpose: Starting point for designing V2 A1 / defender training on the frozen canonical V2 A0 benchmark. No training has been run against this benchmark.
statement: Existing A1 checkpoints are V1-trained and MUST NOT be used as canonical V2 results.

research.a0_environment_commit_note: last commit that changed simulation code; `git diff 8e2d591 journal-v2-a0-canonical-v1 -- uav_defend` is empty

visualizer.tag_note: points at the inspected commit plus one pin-only commit that moves EXPECTED_RESEARCH_COMMIT to the frozen research tag target; no visualizer behavior changed

canonical_config.guard: experiments.journal_v2_protocol.assert_canonical_v2_training_config; pass require_canonical_v2=True to the journal training runners

a1_interface_as_currently_implemented.note: From the V1 adaptive-attacker implementation (experiments/adaptive_attacker_env.py); rewards and training environment are NOT yet redesigned for V2.

a1_v2_training_protocol.canonical_model: checkpoints/final_model.zip with final_model.manifest.json (SHA-256); best_validation.zip is diagnostic only
a1_v2_training_protocol.runner: python -m experiments.journal_v2_a1_training --seed {201|202|203} --train   (--dry-run stops before PPO construction)

v1_checkpoints_provenance_only.warning: Existing A1 checkpoints are V1-trained and MUST NOT be used as canonical V2 results.
v1_checkpoints_provenance_only.registry_sha256_note: file hash of the registry at freeze time; the registry is untracked and an existing evaluation test rewrites it with a fresh `generated_at`, so verify the per-checkpoint sha256 entries (30/30), not the registry file hash
v1_checkpoints_provenance_only.defender_checkpoints: 27 (ppo_clutter_v1, ppo_kalman_clutter_v1, lrppo_clutter_v1 x d0 / d0_plus / d1 x 3 seeds), all V1-trained

training_contract: Pass require_canonical_v2=True to run_adaptive_attacker_training, run_clutter_training and run_defender_adaptation_training.

AdaptiveAttackerTrainingEnv must be given clutter_config_fn=build_randomized_v2_training_config; RandomizedClutterWrapper currently re-samples a V1 config on every reset and must not be used unchanged for V2 defender training.
Do not change any frozen A0 component; a change requires a new benchmark version.
